module.title: Marine (Floating Barge) Drilling - JSA Review
module.description: Operational competency module covering hazards, controls, environmental management, marine transfer procedures, and emergency response requirements for drilling operations undertaken from a floating barge.
learningObjectives: Identify the key hazards associated with floating barge drilling operations.
Apply required controls for marine transfers, rig operation, lifting activities, and drilling tasks.
Demonstrate understanding of emergency response and environmental protection requirements.
Recognise stop-work conditions including unsafe weather, vessel movement, spills, and uncontrolled hazards.
Confirm operational readiness through successful completion of the competency quiz.

contentBody.title: Marine (Floating Barge) Drilling - JSA Review
contentBody.subtitle: Self-directed review module for floating barge drilling operations.

slides.title: Marine drilling requires controlled work
slides.body: Use this module to review the floating barge drilling JSA before confirming readiness for marine drilling operations.
meta: Format: self-directed JSA review plus quiz
slides.fact: Stop work when marine conditions or controls are unsafe

slides.title: Key hazards to identify
bullets: Floating barge movement, unstable access, unsafe transfer conditions, and changing weather can affect worker safety.
Drilling, rig operation, lifting activities, and marine transfers require planned controls before work starts.
Spills, uncontrolled hazards, or emergency conditions require immediate escalation.

slides.title: Operational controls to confirm
checklist: Review the controlled JSA before starting work.
Confirm marine transfer requirements and safe access controls.
Confirm rig operation, lifting, and drilling controls are in place.
Confirm emergency response and environmental protection requirements.
Stop and escalate if weather, vessel movement, spills, or other uncontrolled hazards make the work unsafe.

slides.title: Learner readiness check
checklist: I can identify the main hazards associated with floating barge drilling.
I can describe the required controls for marine transfers and drilling tasks.
I know the emergency response and environmental protection expectations.
I know when to stop work and escalate unsafe conditions.

quiz.question: What is the main purpose of this module?
options: To confirm understanding of hazards, controls, emergency response, and environmental requirements for floating barge drilling.
To replace the controlled JSA for all marine work.
To allow drilling to continue when weather or vessel movement is unsafe.
To remove the need for supervisor review.
quiz.explanation: The module supports JSA review and readiness confirmation; it does not replace controlled procedures or supervisor expectations.

quiz.question: Which condition should trigger stop-work and escalation?
options: Unsafe weather, vessel movement, spills, or uncontrolled hazards.
A completed quiz with no source document review.
quiz.explanation: The module objectives specifically call out unsafe weather, vessel movement, spills, and uncontrolled hazards as stop-work conditions.

quiz.question: What should be reviewed before confirming competency?
options: The controlled floating barge drilling JSA and the required operational controls.
Only previous experience on land-based drilling.
quiz.explanation: The learner must understand the source JSA and the controls for marine transfers, rig operation, lifting, drilling, emergency response, and environmental protection.

competencies.title: Marine (Floating Barge) Drilling - JSA Review
competencies.description: Understands hazards, controls, emergency response, environmental management, marine transfer procedures, and stop-work conditions for drilling operations undertaken from a floating barge.
